name: Hikami Kuon
source: Kuon is the girl Souichi is tasked to protect. They first met each other at the park but, did not know of one another. As soon as Kuon finds out that Souichi is the new transfer student, she becomes close to Souichi which causes an uproar in the school. She is also Natsuki´s childhood friend.
